facts.statement: The Men's Cruiser is described as a minimal, modern court shoe designed for urban comfort and life on the go.
facts.quote:
Why we made this

Minimal and modern, our signature classic court shoe delivers the right balance of style and urban comfort. Lightweight, breathable, and made to move, this is your new go-to for life on the go.

facts.statement: The Men's Cruiser has a breathable TENCEL™ Lyocell blend upper, Merino wool-blend lining, Featherbed™ memory foam insole, and sugarcane-based SweetFoam® cushioning.
facts.quote:
Breathable TENCEL™ Lyocell (tree fiber) blend upper for a light, cool feel
- **Merino wool-blend lining** for softness, socks optional
- Plush **Featherbed™ memory foam** insole for extra comfort and bounce
- Sugarcane-based **SweetFoam® cushioning** with responsive energy return

facts.statement: The Men's Cruiser's Tree Knit upper uses eucalyptus-derived TENCEL™ Lyocell yarn and recycled polyester blend.
facts.quote:
UpperTree Knit

Knit upper made from eucalyptus-derived TENCEL™ Lyocell (tree fiber) yarn and recycled polyester blend

facts.statement: The Men's Cruiser's SweetFoam® midsole uses sugarcane-based EVA foam for comfort and durability.
facts.quote:
MidsoleSweetFoam®

SweetFoam® sugarcane-based EVA foam provides comfort and durability while being light on the planet

facts.statement: Baabuk is presented as an Allbirds alternative and makes sneakers described as equally comfortable but longer lasting.
facts.quote: Baabuk is a Swiss brand that makes sneakers that are just as comfortable as Allbirds but longer lasting.

facts.statement: Gottstein is presented as an understated Allbirds alternative offering wool sneakers with breathable, moisture-wicking, water-repellent, and temperature-regulating properties.
facts.quote: Gottstein offers a handful of understated wool sneaker styles. Each with a wool upper and wool-topped insole providing the full benefits of wool—breathable, moisture-wicking , water-repellent, and temperature-regulating.

facts.statement: Icebug is presented as an Allbirds alternative for running and offers Aura ReWool runners and Eide ReWool everyday sneakers.
facts.quote: The most similar options to Allbirds are the Aura ReWool runners or Eide ReWool everday sneakers.

facts.statement: A Reddit commenter says they prefer Columbia Konos over their Allbirds and describes Columbia as mainly a hiking and trail-running shoe company.
facts.quote: The most comfortable shoes I own and definitely pick over my AllBirds are Columbia Konos. They're mainly an hiking/trail running shoe company

facts.statement: Allbirds offers a standard 30-day return policy for eligible items.
facts.quote: Our standard return policy is 30 days. You can return or exchange items that are unworn and unwashed with original product tags attached within 30 days from the date your order was delivered.

facts.statement: Socks, underwear, and accessories must have unopened packaging to qualify for returns or exchanges.
facts.quote: For socks, undies, and accessories packaging must be unopened. Final Sale items, or returns that do not comply with our terms and conditions cannot be returned or exchanged.

facts.statement: Customers are responsible for return shipping charges, and paid shipping fees are not refunded.
facts.quote: Return Shipping: Customers are responsible for return shipping charges. Paid shipping fees will not be refunded. Refunds will only be applied to the original form of payment.

facts.statement: Return coverage includes a return shipping label for free returns or exchanges.
facts.quote: When you opt-in for coverage at checkout, your return shipping label is included, allowing you to return any item(s) in your order for a refund or exchange for free.

facts.statement: Allbirds states that its orders are processed within one to six business days.
facts.quote: ALL ORDERS ARE PROCESSED WITHIN 1-6 BUSINESS DAYS.

facts.statement: Allbirds was founded in 2014 with a grant from the New Zealand government to help increase the market for wool.
facts.quote: Allbirds was founded in 2014 with a grant from the New Zealand government to help tackle this problem by increasing the market for wool.
